content: 1. A comparison was conducted between 1-2 NAA (non-aspirin NSAIDs) and 23 NAA in terms of their effects. 2. The studies were categorized into prospective and retrospective designs. 3. For prospective studies, the relative risk (RR) was calculated as 0.927 with a 95% confidence interval (CI) ranging from 0.365 to 2.35. 4. For retrospective studies, the relative risk (RR) was determined to be 3.386 with a 95% confidence interval (CI) ranging from 1.364 to 8.408. 5. When combining all studies (overall analysis), the relative risk (RR) was 1.798 with a 95% confidence interval (CI) of 0.938 to 3.447. 6. A separate comparison was made between 1-2 NAA and 253 NAA. 7. In the overall analysis for this comparison, the relative risk (RR) was calculated as 2.367 with a 95% confidence interval (CI) ranging from 0.216 to 25.941. 8. The total number of studies included in the analysis was 2 for the 1-2 NAA vs. 23 NAA comparison and 6 for the 1-2 NAA vs. 253 NAA comparison.
